text:
sara.k: Heads-up — turned on the new FP8 kernel build on H100 + L40S for atlas-13b canary. Seeing subtle token-shift on ~8k token prompts (generation drifts after ~1k tokens). Not a full crash but measurable quality drift.

trevor: ugh. can you paste a minimal repro and the canary config?

sara.k: repro: run ./eval_longform.sh --model atlas-13b --fp8-kernel=enabled --quant=fp8 --device=h100. Diff against same run with --fp8-kernel=disabled shows divergence in next-token probs.

mina: any error logs or NaNs?

sara.k: no NaNs. Logs show tiny differences in attention scores starting at layer 10. Example snippet: ```attn_score_layer10[0:5] FP32: [1.234, 0.987, ...] FP8: [1.230, 0.991, ...]```

ravi: could be residual scaling / accumulator precision mismatch in fused matmul + add kernels. FP8 accumulation may be doing a narrower accumulate path on L40S vs H100.

trevor: also check kv-cache tile alignment and padding differences — long-context artifacts often come from subtle tiling/stride differences.

sara.k: ran layer-diff: dump two layer outputs (fp32 baseline vs fp8 kernel) and compare L2 norms. Divergence grows multiplicatively after layer 10.

mina: hypothesis: mixed-precision path uses a flattened sum with float16 accumulation on one backend and fp32 on another; small rounding bias accumulates. Try forcing fp32 accumulation for matmul in the runtime and see if drift goes away.

ravi: +1. Another quick check: run with single-layer swap: enable FP8 kernels only up to layer 9, keep rest FP32. If drift stops, that points to a specific layer/kernel mismatch.

sara.k: doing single-layer swap now. Also will run a deterministic seed run to rule out RNG.

ci-bot: canary deployment update: atlas-13b fp8-kernel canary at 5% traffic in prod-eu; health ok but latency +1.3ms.

trevor: if drift is reproducible in isolated eval, isolate the kernel (matmul+add fusion) and run microbenchmarks with known inputs. Dump intermediate accumulators.

mina: quick mitigation while debugging: add a routing policy to prefer FP32 kernel for long sequences (>2k tokens) or fallback to compatible quant variant (AWQ/GPTQ) for canary customers.

sara.k: single-layer swap result: when layers 11-26 forced FP32, drift disappears in all runs. So it's localized.

ravi: bingo. Now bisect within 11-26. Start with 11-18 vs 19-26 to narrow. Also capture per-layer attention score diffs and residual scales.

trevor: possible fix paths: 1) adjust residual_scale applied in FP8 conversion (off-by-power-of-two), 2) change accumulator precision, 3) kernel rework to match reference layout.

mina: remind: differences between H100 and L40S kernels — H100 uses fused GEMM + epilogue that assumes pre-scaled weights; L40S kernel might do post-scale. Check where scaling is applied relative to bias add.

sara.k: logging to S3: s3://redwood-canary/atlas13b/fp8-diffs/2155009999/*. Will share scripts shortly.

ravi: if we need a quick rollback: revert fp8-kernel flag in the canary config and promote patched kernel later. Avoid broad rollback — traffic is tiny but important customers hit longform.

deploy-bot: rollback candidate created: canary-config/atlas13b/fp8-disable-2155010300 (runbook: revert flag, monitor perplexity, watch for <0.5% quality regression on synthetic eval).

mina: next steps for eng-ml: bisect layers, capture accumulators, try forcing fp32 accumulation and re-run microbench, compare AWQ/GPTQ paths to see if quant backend matters.

sara.k: assigning to @trevor and @ravi to own kernel bisect. I'll continue producing diffs and test patches for residual_scale. Thanks all :thumbsup:

trevor: I'll start bisecting now. If anyone sees a quick guess patch for scaling offsets, ping me.

ravi: prepping a small test harness to run on both H100 and L40S to reproduce kernel-local behavior. Should have results in ~3 hours.

sara.k: noted, will postpone canary expansion until we have a patch.

ci-bot: test run queued: integration-longseq-atlas13b-fp8-bisect (id: 78922). Results ETA ~2h.
